subject: Temporary throttle extension request + billing credit consideration
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@fintechx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: temporary throughput increase and billing credit request

Hi Rishi,

We had an unexpected traffic surge on our payments pipeline earlier this morning after a partner campaign went live. Our integration is calling Redwood endpoints and we started hitting rate limits ~08:40 PDT — several customer flows got delayed. We’ve mitigated most of it but will still need higher throughput for the next 36-48 hours while we backfill.

Can Redwood temporarily increase our per-minute rate limit to 5x baseline for the next 48 hours? Second ask — given this was an unforeseen one-off caused by a partner redirect that we couldn’t throttle immediately, would Redwood consider a billing offset or credit for the overrun tokens during this window? We’re a committed customer but the spike was anomalous and we’d like to avoid a surprise bill.

Attached: traffic-surge-logs.csv (light scrubbed) — it shows the spike timestamps and request sources.

We can start the burst window as soon as you confirm. Please advise next steps and any timelines you need.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Integrations, FinTechX
alyssa.chen@fintechx.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary throughput increase and billing credit request

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry you ran into that. We can help here.

Options I can put in place immediately:
- Emergency burst: increase your per-minute throughput to 5x current cap for a configurable window (we typically allow 24–72 hours). This is implemented at the routing layer; no code changes needed on your side.
- Capped goodwill credit: we can apply a one-time credit to offset the token overrun up to an agreed cap. Any overrun beyond the cap would be billed at the standard overage rate.
- Pre-authorized temporary top-up: if you prefer, we can enable a temporary quota top-up that will be billed at end of month (no immediate action required).

I’ve attached a short note with the emergency burst parameters and proposed credit levels (burst_proposal_20260601.pdf). To move forward I need: (1) confirmation of the window you want (start/end), and (2) which option you prefer for the billing handling (credit cap amount or pre-authorized top-up).

Laura/Vivek — looping you in to approve the suggested 48-hr burst and to confirm the finance side on the credit thresholds.

If you’re ready, I can flip the burst on within 20 minutes of confirmation.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary throughput increase and billing credit request

Quick internal — I approve an emergency 48-hour burst for FinTechX at 5x baseline as a one-time concession to keep their production flows healthy. Approve up to $2,500 in one-time credit to cover the token overrun for that window. Any credit beyond $2,500 must go through finance for a formal write-off.

Vivek — please confirm you can process the $2,500 credit (will be applied as an invoice credit against the June billing cycle) and advise if any additional docs are required from the customer (e.g., signed statement). If finance wants a DocuSign confirmation we can generate a short acknowledgement.

Rishi — once you have Alyssa’s confirmation for the start time, proceed to enable the burst and notify CS so they can monitor.

Laura
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@fintechx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary throughput increase and billing credit request

Hi Rishi — thanks and thank you, Laura. We accept the 48-hour 5x burst starting now (please start immediately). The $2,500 goodwill credit cap is fine; we appreciate the quick turnaround.

Start time: 2026-06-01T16:45:00-07:00
End time: 2026-06-03T16:45:00-07:00

We’ll monitor on our end and keep you updated if traffic normalizes sooner. If you need any written confirmation for the credit, send over the short acknowledgement and I’ll have our finance sign it.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Integrations, FinTechX
